guard: The post-publish closure gate checks every package in the lockstep group against the registry, validates response bodies, and gates the GitHub Release on the result
why: The release workflow used to check one package of twenty-two and cut a Release on that alone. A sibling that failed to publish was invisible. The closure gate now checks every package and the Release step depends on it.
A 200 without a body identifying the package at the requested version is no longer treated as presence. Each mutation below breaks one property the smoke is supposed to hold.

mutations.name: the closure-gate step is removed from the workflow
mutations.expectRed: the version job has a step with id 'closure-gate'
mutations.cell: the version job has a step with id 'closure-gate'

mutations.name: the release step stops referencing the closure-gate output
mutations.expectRed: the release step's 'if' references the closure-gate step output
mutations.cell: the release step's 'if' references the closure-gate step output

mutations.name: the closure-gate step stops invoking verify-publish-closure.mjs
the body validation is removed so any 200 counts as presence again
